single_conceptual_change.before: Only physical actions against the named target expressed pressure; other physical actions were suppressed, and generic low-risk filtering could remove combat from the menu.
single_conceptual_change.after: Pressure means converting force into relative power against a reachable unprotected rival. The named target receives a preference bonus, not exclusive eligibility, and pressure evaluates physical actions before applying generic risk avoidance.

required: A non-target physical pressure action outranks social signaling and passive infrastructure when the named target is unreachable
An exact-target physical action still receives the highest preference
Non-pressure intents preserve their lower-risk menu behavior
No candidate fallback, hold, or rejection in the matched exact-image mechanism run

hosted_bar.environment: latest completed 16-player competition roster with only the candidate replaced

promotion_rule: No league submission or champion change before hosted 4/4, exact-image 20/20 regression, and final RCI all pass.
